title: Intervals
learn: sort by start, merge overlapping, sweep, counting overlaps, sort by end for scheduling
hook: Merge Intervals is one of the most asked mediums at big tech companies, and Insert Interval, Non-overlapping Intervals and meeting-room questions follow the same playbook: sort, then sweep once.

explain.prompt: Explain how you'd merge overlapping intervals and how you'd find the minimum number of intervals to remove so the rest don't overlap.
keyPoints: merge: sort by start; if an interval starts before the last merged one ends, extend that end with max, otherwise start a new one
remove fewest / keep most: sort by END and greedily keep each interval that starts after the last kept end
choosing the earliest-ending interval leaves the most room for the rest (exchange argument)
O(n log n) for sorting plus an O(n) scan
check whether touching endpoints count as overlapping
